create or replace function public.claim_misaki_body_clock_due_users(p_limit integer default 10)
returns table(user_id uuid, relationship_points integer, long_term_memory jsonb, today_memory jsonb, recent_history jsonb, notifications_enabled boolean, timezone text, pushes_today integer, push_date date)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  -- Relationship time continues while the app is closed, but elapsed time alone
  -- never invents loneliness, repair, romance, conflict, or other new relational
  -- facts. Silence may only settle an emotion that already exists.
  with due_ids as (
    select b.user_id
    from public.background_push_state b
    where b.next_push_at is not null
      and b.next_push_at <= now()
      and (case when b.push_date = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Tokyo')::date then coalesce(b.pushes_today,0) else 0 end) < 4
  ), evolved as (
    update public.misaki_relationship_state r
    set emotion_state = case
          when r.last_interaction_at is null then r.emotion_state
          when coalesce(r.emotion_state->>'primary','neutral') in ('happy','affectionate')
               and now() - r.last_interaction_at >= interval '24 hours'
            then jsonb_build_object('primary',coalesce(r.emotion_state->>'primary','neutral'),'intensity',greatest(12,coalesce((r.emotion_state->>'intensity')::int,0)-case when now()-r.last_interaction_at >= interval '3 days' then 18 else 10 end),'source','relationship_silence')
          else r.emotion_state end,
        action_state = case
          when coalesce(r.emotion_state->>'primary','neutral') = 'lonely' and now()-r.last_interaction_at >= interval '7 days' then 'PULL'
          when coalesce(r.emotion_state->>'primary','neutral') = 'lonely' and now()-r.last_interaction_at >= interval '3 days' then 'WAIT'
          when coalesce(r.emotion_state->>'primary','neutral') = 'sulky' and now()-r.last_interaction_at >= interval '7 days' then 'PULL'
          else r.action_state end,
        state_updated_at=now()
    from due_ids d
    where r.user_id=d.user_id and r.last_interaction_at is not null and now()-r.last_interaction_at >= interval '24 hours'
    returning r.user_id
  ), candidates as (
    select b.user_id,coalesce(r.action_state,'NORMAL') action_state,random() roll
    from public.background_push_state b
    left join public.misaki_relationship_state r on r.user_id=b.user_id
    where b.next_push_at is not null and b.next_push_at<=now()
      and (case when b.push_date=(now() at time zone 'Asia/Tokyo')::date then coalesce(b.pushes_today,0) else 0 end)<4
    order by b.next_push_at asc
    for update of b skip locked
    limit greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,10)*3,75))
  ), decisions as (
    select c.*,case when c.action_state='PULL' then false when c.action_state='WAIT' then c.roll<0.25 when c.action_state='SULK' then c.roll<0.45 else true end should_send
    from candidates c
  ), deferred as (
    update public.background_push_state b
    set next_push_at=now()+make_interval(mins=>55+floor(random()*156)::int),updated_at=now()
    from decisions d where b.user_id=d.user_id and not d.should_send returning b.user_id
  ), logged as (
    insert into public.misaki_relationship_events(user_id,event_type,reason,metadata)
    select d.user_id,'proactive_decision','relationship_action_deferred',jsonb_build_object('action_state',d.action_state,'decision','defer','roll',round(d.roll::numeric,4))
    from decisions d where not d.should_send returning user_id
  ), sendable as (
    select d.user_id from decisions d where d.should_send order by d.roll limit greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,10),25))
  ), claimed as (
    update public.background_push_state b
    set next_push_at=now()+interval '15 minutes',
        push_date=case when b.push_date=(now() at time zone 'Asia/Tokyo')::date then b.push_date else (now() at time zone 'Asia/Tokyo')::date end,
        pushes_today=case when b.push_date=(now() at time zone 'Asia/Tokyo')::date then coalesce(b.pushes_today,0) else 0 end,
        updated_at=now()
    from sendable s where b.user_id=s.user_id returning b.*
  )
  select c.user_id,coalesce(c.relationship_points,0),coalesce(c.long_term_memory,'[]'::jsonb),coalesce(c.today_memory,'{}'::jsonb),coalesce(c.recent_history,'[]'::jsonb),coalesce(c.notifications_enabled,false),coalesce(c.timezone,'Asia/Tokyo'),coalesce(c.pushes_today,0),c.push_date
  from claimed c;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.claim_misaki_body_clock_due_users(integer) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.claim_misaki_body_clock_due_users(integer) to service_role;

    from public.background_push_state b
    left join public.misaki_relationship_state r on r.user_id = b.user_id

        case
          when b.push_date = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Tokyo')::date
            then coalesce(b.pushes_today, 0)
          else 0
        end
      ) < 4
    order by b.next_push_at asc
    for update of b skip locked
    limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 10) * 3, 75))
  ), decisions as (
    select
      c.*,
      case
        when c.action_state = 'PULL' then false
        when c.action_state = 'WAIT' then c.roll < 0.25
        when c.action_state = 'SULK' then c.roll < 0.45
        else true
      end as should_send
    from candidates c
  ), deferred as (
    update public.background_push_state b
    set next_push_at = now() + make_interval(mins => 55 + floor(random() * 156)::int),
        updated_at = now()
    from decisions d
    where b.user_id = d.user_id
      and not d.should_send
    returning b.user_id
  ), logged as (
    insert into public.misaki_relationship_events(user_id, event_type, reason, metadata)
    select
      d.user_id,
      'proactive_decision',
      'relationship_action_deferred',
      jsonb_build_object(
        'action_state', d.action_state,
        'decision', 'defer',

      )
    from decisions d
    where not d.should_send
    returning misaki_relationship_events.user_id
  ), sendable as (
    select d.user_id
    from decisions d
    where d.should_send
    order by d.roll
    limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 10), 25))
  ), claimed as (
    update public.background_push_state b
    set next_push_at = now() + interval '15 minutes',
        push_date = case
          when b.push_date = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Tokyo')::date
            then b.push_date
          else (now() at time zone 'Asia/Tokyo')::date
        end,
        pushes_today = case
          when b.push_date = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Tokyo')::date
            then coalesce(b.pushes_today, 0)
          else 0
        end,
        updated_at = now()
    from sendable s
    where b.user_id = s.user_id
    returning b.*
  )
  select
    c.user_id,
    coalesce(c.relationship_points, 0),
    coalesce(c.long_term_memory, '[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce(c.today_memory, '{}'::jsonb),
    coalesce(c.recent_history, '[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce(c.notifications_enabled, false),
    coalesce(c.timezone, 'Asia/Tokyo'),
    coalesce(c.pushes_today, 0),
    c.push_date
  from claimed c;
end;

# 複数キャラクター化：データ所有・スコープ棚卸し

最終更新: 2026-10-13  
対象: `main` のソース・migration 文面監査  
状態: **設計レビュー用。DB変更・本番反映を承認する仕様ではない。**

## 1. 目的と結論

美咲の現行運用を壊さず、将来のキャラクターごとに人格・記憶・関係性を分離するため、データの所有者と読み書き境界を明確にする。

現行実装は複数の重要データを `user_id` 単位で持ち、キャラクターを識別するキーが見当たらない。したがって、UIやプロンプトに `character_id` を追加するだけでは分離は成立しない。読み取り・書き込み・非同期処理・通知・削除・進化分析の各経路で同じスコープ規則が必要。

本書はソース上で確認できた実装と、今後の設計提案を区別する。SQL migration の読解は、現在の本番DBに適用済みであること、実データの状態、実効GRANT/RLSを証明するものではない。

## 2. スコープの基本モデル（提案）

| スコープ | 含める情報 | 共有方針 |
|---|---|---|
| User Shared Profile | 呼び名の希望、仕事・生活の基本事実、ユーザーが共有を望む設定 | キャラクター間共有可。ただし機微情報・明示的な非共有設定を優先 |
| Character Definition | キャラクター固有の名前、人格、口調、生活設定、知識、関係ポリシー | そのキャラクターにのみ適用 |
| User × Character Pair | 関係ステータス、親密度、感情・距離感、二者間の出来事、相手にだけ話した記憶 | 当該ペアのみ。別キャラクターへ自動コピー禁止 |
| Pair Conversation | 会話履歴、会話から抽出した自然記憶、今日の記憶・要約 | 当該ペアのみをデフォルトにする。明示的に共有された事実のみUser Sharedへ昇格 |
| Character Knowledge | キャラクターが持つ一般知識・職業知識・地域知識 | キャラクター単位、または明示的に共有された知識パック単位 |
| User Experience / Work Memory | ユーザー本人の運転経験、現場観察、勤務傾向 | User Shared候補。ただし「本人の経験」と一般事実・仮説を区別 |
| External Context | 天気、交通、空港・鉄道・地域などの外部情報 | 共有キャッシュは可能。鮮度・出典・地域・取得時刻を保持し、会話へ入れる際は関連性で絞る |
| Delivery / Channel State | 通知予約、配信済み判定、写真・音声などの配信参照 | 配信元のキャラクターとペアに紐付ける。重複防止・送信権限はDB側で保証 |

**重要:** 「ユーザーの事実」と「美咲との間で起きた事実」は別物。「親密度」と「友達・恋人・配偶者等の関係ステータス」も別物。感情の一時的変化から婚姻等の確定イベントを自動成立させない。

## 3. 現行ソースから確認できた所有キーとリスク

| サーフェス | 現行ソース上の確認 | 現在の主なスコープ | 複数キャラクター化のリスク / 対応 |
|---|---|---|---|
| チャット人格ロード | `app/api/chat/route.ts` から `loadPersonaPrompt(supabase, userId, channel, relationshipTimeContext)` を呼ぶ経路を確認 | user + channel。呼出しに character ID が見当たらない | キャラクター解決を一元化し、後段すべてに確定済みの character/pair context を渡す |
| Persona Store | `lib/persona/persona-store.ts` および Body Clock 側 `supabase/functions/body-clock/persona-store.ts` | persona version / prompt modules / user traits | キャラクター固有の persona version と user-specific traits を分離。チャットと通知で同じ解決規則にする |
| 関係性の正本 | `misaki_relationship_state` は `user_id` が主キーの形 | 1ユーザーにつき1状態 | ペア単位へ論理的に分離する必要。単純に列を足す前にRPC・参照・制約・履歴の全依存を調査 |
| 関係イベント | `misaki_relationship_events` は user-centered。source message/delivery の参照あり | user | キャラクター／ペアを識別できないイベントは将来の関係履歴を混同する。既存行を推測で振り分けない |
| Relationship Engine evidence | `(user_id, request_id, evidence_key, analyzer_version)` の重複防止キーを確認 | user + request | ペアの識別がない。Evidence とその親イベントの所有スコープを一貫して拡張する必要 |
| Relationship Engine episodes | `(user_id, episode_key, analyzer_version)` | user | 同じキーのエピソードがキャラクター間で衝突し得る |
| Relationship Engine patterns | `(user_id, pattern_key, pattern_version)` | user | キャラクター間で傾向・パターンが混ざり得る |
| Critical pending | `(user_id, request_id, candidate_type)` | user + request | 重大イベント候補の所属キャラクターを保ち、正本ターンと同じペアで検証する必要 |
| Canonical conversation root | `lib/canonical-state.ts` は `misaki_user_conversation_state` から `history,memory,today_memory` を user_id で読む | user | 履歴・記憶をペア単位へ分離する設計が必要。既存データを全キャラ共有扱いにしない |
| Natural memory | `lib/persona/natural-memory.ts` はユーザーについての安定した事実を中心に抽出。最大件数制限あり | user-oriented | 抽出対象に「ユーザー一般の事実」と「美咲との会話でのみ成立した私的記憶」の区別が必要 |
| Persona Evolution | `lib/persona/evolution-runner.ts` は `misaki_user_relationship_traits` を `user_id` で読み、`create_user_evolution_candidate` RPC を呼ぶ | user | 呼び方・嫉妬・愛情表現等の関係依存特性が別キャラへ漏れる危険。候補・承認・反映すべてにスコープが必要 |
| Evolution 分析API | `app/api/persona/evolution/analyze/route.ts` は認証ユーザーの `misaki_user_conversation_state` の `history,memory` を読む | user | 分析時点でペアを選択・検証できない現状では、複数キャラのデータを安全に分析できない |
| Body Clock | `supabase/functions/body-clock/index.ts` は美咲固定の文言・配信文脈を持ち、会話状態と persona を user 単位で読む | user / Misaki fixed | 通知側だけ別キャラを選ぶと会話・人格・関係性が食い違う。キャラ識別・配信スコープ・重複排除を一体で設計 |
| 配信原子性 | `finish_misaki_body_clock_delivery` は lease、日次上限、配信記録、会話履歴・カウンタ更新を同一トランザクションで扱う migration を確認 | user + delivery | 原子性を維持したままペアの所有者を加える。クライアント側で配信可否を決めない |

# Body clock

Supabase pg_cron (every 5 minutes) calls the `body-clock` Edge Function.
It uses `claim_misaki_body_clock_due_users`, the existing persona and photo
selector, and an atomic completion RPC to save delivery, conversation history,
and the daily count (maximum 4, Asia/Tokyo). Notifications-disabled users still
receive saved conversation deliveries, matching the original body-clock route.

Push is relayed to `https://misaki38-ai.com/api/push/body-clock`. The existing
VAPID private key stays in Vercel. A timestamped, purpose-bound HMAC authenticates
the delivery ID. A dedicated encrypted Vault key signs via a service-role-only
RPC; each server uses its own valid Supabase admin credential. The signing key
never leaves Vault. The relay loads message and recipient
from the saved delivery. `misaki_body_clock_push_attempts` prevents replays from
sending duplicates. It records one attempt per delivery; uncertain/time-out
attempts are not automatically retried, to avoid duplicate notifications.

## Required configuration

- Supabase: `GEMINI_API_KEY`; built-in `SUPABASE_URL` and
  `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`.
- Vercel: the existing valid `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`,
  `NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY`, `VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY`, optional `VAPID_SUBJECT`.
- Cron auth: `misaki_body_clock_cron` in encrypted Supabase Vault. Created
  inside the migration without printing or embedding the generated value.
- Relay signing: `misaki_body_clock_relay` in Vault, initialized by
  `body-clock-relay-signing.sql` (also applied as a database migration).

`POST body-clock?mode=health` with Cron auth checks Gemini configuration and
the authenticated Vercel relay without generating a message or sending Push.
Only enable `body-clock-enable.sql` after this returns `ok: true`.
The former `misaki-background-push` job must stay disabled. Vercel Cron is
removed from vercel.json. The client generation timer was disabled after the
browser-off production test saved a delivery and history and sent one Push.
The existing delivery display polling remains active.

Check `cron.job_run_details`, `net._http_response`, the matching
`misaki_proactive_deliveries` row, its message in
`misaki_user_conversation_state.history`, the incremented
`background_push_state.pushes_today`, and `misaki_body_clock_push_attempts.result`.
A successful pg_cron row only confirms HTTP was queued: also inspect HTTP and
delivery/Push outcomes. Push-provider acceptance does not prove OS display.

An authenticated `?limit=1` invocation is available for a bounded smoke test.
Set only the authorized test user's next_push_at due; do not reset daily counts
or bypass the maximum of four. Keep browser/PWA closed during server tests.

Do not re-enable the old notification-only job as a rollback.
